blocks.html: Notwithstanding Section 27-751 of the 1968 Building Code, Section 27-2087 of the Housing Maintenance Code, Section 1208.2, and any applicable laws in existence prior to December 6, 1968, a basement or cellar ADU in a one-family dwelling may be occupied in accordance with the provisions of this Appendix, or a basement or cellar ADU in a one- or two-family dwelling in the program area may be occupied in accordance with Article 507 of Chapter 5 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code.
